name: qlrisk_frtb_ima_capital
title: FRTB Internal Models Approach capital
description: FRTB IMA capital (MAR31/33). mode='full' runs the book end to end: liquidity-horizon-adjusted, stress-calibrated ES and IMCC, stressed ES for non-modellable factors (nmrf), the IMA default risk charge (two-factor Gaussian copula, from ratings) and capital = max(IMCC + SES, m x avg60) + DRC. Other modes: 'imcc', 'lh_es' (liquidity-adjusted ES only), 'liquidity_horizons' (MAR33.12 horizon per factor), 'rfet' (risk-factor eligibility test on real-price observation dates), 'ima_drc' (on positions you supply) and 'capital' (from IMCC, SES and DRC numbers). Example: {"mode": "rfet", "as_of": "2026-10-09", "observations": {"CR.GLOBEX.5Y": ["2026-09-30", "2026-08-29"]}}.
